sectionSubtitle: Professional journey in data engineering, AI, and full-stack development

experiences.title: Senior Data Engineer
contents: Working on enterprise data platform and governance initiatives, supporting the implementation of data infrastructure and access controls across multiple environments.
Contributing to Snowflake governance and security practices, including RBAC, masking policies, and controlled access for regulated datasets.
Supporting source onboarding and data ingestion workflows using Fivetran, ADLS (Iceberg), and Snowflake for analytics and reporting use cases.
Improving CI/CD reliability and deployment consistency with GitHub Actions, secure configuration practices, and troubleshooting of platform and access-related issues.
Collaborating on platform maintenance, documentation, and technical problem-solving to help keep the environment stable, secure, and easier to operate.

experiences.title: Senior Data Engineer (Full-Stack & Data Products)
contents: Developed and operated large-scale data ingestion platforms using Python, Azure Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake, and SQL, processing high-volume data from APIs, web sources, and enterprise systems.
Designed and optimized ETL/ELT workflows orchestrated with Airflow and Azure Data Factory for structured and semi-structured datasets.
Built data quality, monitoring, and alerting frameworks, including completeness checks, anomaly detection, schema drift handling, and SLA tracking.
Optimized SQL transformations, indexing strategies, and query plans for high-volume analytical workloads.
Developed backend automation and services using Python and Azure Functions to orchestrate ingestion flows, manage retries, and handle failure recovery.
Implemented observability dashboards using Power BI and Elasticsearch/Kibana to track freshness, ingestion health, error rates, and processing latency.
Partnered with engineering, product, and operations teams in agile delivery, owning ingestion components end to end and contributing to architecture decisions around scalability and reliability.

experiences.title: Freelance Full-Stack Developer & AI Engineer
contents: Delivering project-based full-stack applications using TypeScript (React/Next.js, Node.js) and Python, with focus on product quality, maintainability, and reliable delivery.
Building AI-enabled workflows and retrieval-based applications for knowledge and automation use cases, including LLM integrations, structured outputs, and search/summarization experiences.
Designing backend services, API integrations, authentication flows, and cloud deployments across modern web stacks.
Creating polished user-facing interfaces and selected interactive web experiences, including personal portfolio work that highlights frontend engineering, motion, and visual presentation.
Applying testing, validation, and monitoring practices to improve stability, release confidence, and overall product reliability.

experiences.title: Data Engineer
contents: Designed and delivered interactive Power BI dashboards and automated reporting pipelines using Python, reducing manual reporting effort and expanding self-service analytics for business teams.
Integrated and standardized data from SAP, external APIs, SQL databases, and Azure Data Lake into a centralized analytical environment.
Built distributed processing pipelines with PySpark and SparkSQL, improving performance over legacy processes and accelerating insights for business teams.
Implemented Azure-based data architectures using Synapse Analytics, ADLS, and Databricks to support near real-time reporting.
Developed automated data validation, reconciliation, and anomaly detection routines to improve data accuracy and reduce recurring issues.
Created and maintained KPI dashboards for finance, sales, and operations.
Collaborated with cross-functional stakeholders to define requirements, maintain data dictionaries, document pipelines, and translate technical outputs into actionable insights.

experiences.title: Data Analyst Intern
contents: Consolidated data from Oracle, SQL/NoSQL systems, SAP, and shop-floor IoT sources, contributing to a near real-time analytical environment for operational monitoring.
Developed automated Python scripts for data ingestion, standardization, and cleansing, reducing manual spreadsheet work and accelerating KPI updates.
Designed and delivered interactive Power BI dashboards for tracking production efficiency, machine downtime, and critical operational indicators.
Implemented data validation, reconciliation, and anomaly detection rules to improve data accuracy and reliability.
Partnered with engineers and plant supervisors to define requirements, document data sources, and maintain KPI dictionaries, translating raw operational data into actionable insights.

experiences.title: B.Sc. Chemical Engineering
contents: Education in industrial process analysis, mathematical modeling, and system optimization.
First personal projects with Python automations for data analysis and automated reporting.
Solid foundation in systematic thinking and complex problem solving.
